title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are Hiring: High-Volume Talent Acquisition Specialists Across Kerala & Karnataka

We are expanding rapidly across Kerala and Karnataka and are seeking seasoned talent acquisition specialists capable of independently managing 80 to 100 closures per month.

Please Note: This is strictly a core recruitment role. Freshers, HR generalists, and candidates without proven experience in handling high-volume hiring targets under tight deadlines need not apply.

Locations and Mobility

Openings are available across Kerala and Karnataka, including Cochin, Mangaluru, and our Corporate Head Office in Kozhikode. Candidates must be willing to relocate and comfortable with extensive field travel (up to 75%) across assigned regions for walk-in drives and branch-level hiring.

Key Responsibilities

Independently manage end-to-end recruitment, consistently closing 80 to 100 positions per month.

Hire across both Commercial (sales, retail, operations) and non-commercial (corporate, technical, back-office) verticals.

Execute recruitment across all hierarchies, from executive-level staff to manager-level leadership.

Build and maintain strong local talent pipelines across the Kerala and Karnataka markets.

Candidate Requirements

3 to 5+ years of dedicated, high-volume recruitment experience (retail, telecom, FMCG, BFSI, or staffing agency backgrounds preferred).

Complete ownership of sourcing channels, job portals, field drives, and stakeholder coordination without hand-holding.

Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their updated resume to
careers@myg.in
with the subject line: TA Specialist - [Preferred Region] - [Your Name].

In your email, please clearly mention:

The average number of hires you close per month.

The specific roles and verticals you have hired for so far.

The sourcing platforms and channels that work best for you.
